local_backup_domain.cutover_rule: require no active backup/restore work, stop backup-worker, seal source, exact offline manifest copy into mapper-backed local-backup-vault, switch backend read-only and backup-worker read-write, retain source read-only, then require a new encrypted offsite backup and independent restore before closure

operations_domain.cutover_rule: do not copy stale Redis queues as authority; start the encrypted Redis candidate empty or from an explicitly reconciled safe operational snapshot, then rebuild volatile runtime state from PostgreSQL/durable authorities. Retained sanitized non-container operational logs move to operations-vault or become volatile before FR-06 closure

required_order: FR-06C3A live read-only inventory and contracts
FR-06C3B isolated local-backup physical migration and Redis empty/reconciliation rehearsal
FR-06C3C protected source overlays plus guarded provisioning/cutover executors
FR-06C3D production local-backup-vault cutover with new encrypted backup and independent restore
FR-06C3E production operations-vault Redis/log policy cutover and acceptance
release_boundary: FR-06 remains open. C3A is read-only and authorizes no production vault creation, copy, service stop, Redis flush, log move or Cloudflare change.
